text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black brilliantly achieved the 
Triple Crown. Accomplishing a feat that 
even Tokai Teio couldn't, she deeply moved 
the hearts of the fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio celebrates achieving the Triple 
Crown. Meanwhile, Sakura Bakushin O, 
feeling that her role was over, walked 
away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And as if answering Kitasan Black's 
brilliant run, Satono Diamond claimed 
victory in her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black's next goal is the Arima 
Kinen. Dreaming of reuniting with Satono 
Diamond next year, she steps onto this 
grand stage first on her own.
